title: RFP Translation with VerdeClean for TSMC Arizona
subtitle: English–Mandarin business document translation and collaboration records.
html:
Translation work with VerdeClean

I worked with VerdeClean on English–Mandarin translation for an RFP related to TSMC’s Arizona facility. The email correspondence includes English and Mandarin versions of the RFP and bilingual materials titled TSMC Partnership Overview.

Feedback after the collaboration

Following the work, Amanda Foster thanked me by email for my help with the TSMC RFP translation. Amber Reyna also sent proposed LinkedIn recommendation text praising my speed, thoroughness, quality of work, and reliability. The original email screenshot is included below.

About VerdeClean

Founded in 2019 and based in Phoenix, Arizona, VerdeClean provides commercial cleaning and facilities services, with a focus on environmentally friendly cleaning and healthier workplaces. Its track record includes serving as a cleaning partner to TSMC Arizona.
